title: Open comparison transport on the literal restriction of a complex
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$, and $g':X'\to X$ form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], with derived categories and derived pullbacks [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be open, $j=U.\iota$, $T=X'\times_X U$, $p:T\to X'$, and $q:T\to U$, and use the induced cartesian square $(q,pf',jf,g)$. For $z\in T$ and $i\in\mathbf Z$, let $H$ and $H_U$ be the underlying additive derived stalk-cohomology functors at $pz$ and $z$ [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-source-transport]. There exists a natural isomorphism $\eta:H\cong Lp^*\mathbin{\gg}H_U$, independent of all representatives. For every $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, K-flat sheaf complex $P$ on $X$, specified invertible pullback counit for $g'$ on $P$ [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], and $e_P:\mathrm{DQ}(P)\cong K$, set $Q$ to the literal termwise restriction of $P$ along $j$. There are a K-flatness certificate for $Q$ [lem-pc-kflat-open-restriction], an invertible specified pullback counit $h_{cQ}$ for $q$ on $Q$, and an isomorphism $e_Q:\mathrm{DQ}(Q)\cong Lj^*K$. If $a$ and $b$ are the underlying additive comparisonIntoPullback arrows for $P$ and $Q$ [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-pullback-naturality] and $\beta:Lq^*Lj^*K\to Lp^*L(g')^*K$ is the specified derived-composition transport [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], there is an isomorphism $l$ between their sources such that $a;H(L(g')^*(e_P));\eta_{L(g')^*K}=l;b;H_U(Lq^*(e_Q);\beta)$. Only the literal restricted complex occurs on $U$; there is no arbitrary second representative or supplied identification on $U$.

proof.text: The base change p of j is open. Identify tensor pullback along p and j with exact restriction by uniqueness of adjoints, and their derived functors by the universal counits. Descend the additive restriction-stalk natural isomorphism to complexes, derived categories and cohomology to obtain η independently of P.

Use the literal termwise restriction Q of P. Open restriction preserves K-flatness. The K-flat derived pullback counit gives hcQ. Exact restriction computes derived pullback along j; its canonical identification composed with Lj*(eP) gives eQ. The open-immersion stalk maps identify the old and new local rings, and the pullback condition identifies the base-ring actions. The restriction-stalk extension isomorphism, universal derived tensor extension and final scalar extension identify the comparison sources, giving l.

On literal restrictions, apply comparison_eq and localized_eq to identify comparisons with the universal counits and scalar-extension transposes. Naturality of these counits and tensorStalkIso gives the comparison square. The universal-counit equation for the chosen derived composition comparison identifies the target transport with β. Apply cohomology and forget scalars to obtain the stated equality. There is no arbitrary representative to compare in this lemma.

theorem exists_open_restricted_comparison_transport
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (U : X.Opens)
    (sqU : IsPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') (U.ι ≫ f) g)
    (z : (pullback g' U.ι : Scheme.{u})) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk (pullback.fst g' U.ι z)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let FU := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((pullback g' U.ι).presheaf.stalk z))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let H := comparisonStalkCohomology X' (pullback.fst g' U.ι z) i ⋙ F
    let HU := comparisonStalkCohomology (pullback g' U.ι) z i ⋙ FU
    ∃ η : H ≅ derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι) ⋙ HU,
      ∀ (K : schemeDerivedCategory X)
        (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hP : P.IsKFlat)
        (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
        (eP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K),
      let Q : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ :=
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
      ∃ (hQ : Q.IsKFlat) (hcQ : IsIso ((counit (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q)))
        (eQ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q ≅ (derivedPullback U.ι).obj K),
      let a := F.map (comparisonIntoPullback f f' g g' sq
        (pullback.fst g' U.ι z) P hcP i)
      let b := FU.map (comparisonIntoPullback (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
        g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sqU z Q hcQ i)
      let β :=
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
          (pullback.snd g' U.ι) U.ι).hom.app K ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
          (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := U.ι)).symm) ≫
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
          (pullback.fst g' U.ι) g').inv.app K
      ∃ l : (Arrow.mk a).left ≅ (Arrow.mk b).left,
        a ≫ H.map ((derivedPullback g').map eP.hom) ≫
            η.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj K) =
          l.hom ≫ b ≫ HU.map ((derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).map eQ.hom ≫ β)
